nodes.description: Address holding the module registrar role in AtomicModuleRegistry; guards module whitelisting.
Public mapping(address=>bool) whitelisting exchange modules authorized for delegatecall in AtomicBlue.
Immutable AtomicBlue executor address hardcoded in AtomicTokenProxy (0xAc7E...97A0).
AtomicUtils.balanceOf: universal balance query for ETH or ERC20 tokens held by the contract.
AtomicUtils.send: universal transfer helper using recipient.send for ETH and token.transfer plus return validation for ERC20.
AtomicUtils.claimTokenFromSenderTo: pulls ERC20 via transferFrom(msg.sender, receiver, amount) or requires msg.value == amount for ETH.
AtomicUtils.approve: external token approval with optional-return validation for non-compliant ERC20s.
AtomicUtils.validateOptionalERC20Return: assembly based check of returndatasize/returndatacopy to tolerate missing return values.
AtomicUtils.isETH: treats address(0) and 0xEeee...EEeE sentinel as native ETH.
AtomicUtils.isWETH: checks token address against the hardcoded WETH address constant.
AtomicUtils.sliceBytes: memory slicing helper using unchecked length arithmetic and inline assembly memory copies.
AtomicModuleRegistry.setNewRegistrar: privileged role transfer protected by onlyRegistrar.
AtomicModuleRegistry.registerModule: privileged whitelist update of isModule mapping, protected by onlyRegistrar.
AtomicBlue.swap: external entrypoint forwarding swap to swapAndSend with msg.sender as recipient.
AtomicBlue.doDistributedSwap: splits input across chunks, performs arbitrary call.value or delegatecall to exchange modules, returns buy token balance.
AtomicBlue.swapAndSend: payable entrypoint that performs the distributed swap, checks minOutput and sends output to a user supplied recipient.
AtomicBlue.multiPathSwapAndSend: loops doDistributedSwap across a token path then forwards output to recipient.
AtomicTokenProxy.swapAndSend: pulls sell token from sender then forwards value call to the AtomicBlue executor.
AtomicTokenProxy.multiPathSwapAndSend: claims sell token and forwards the multi-path swap to AtomicBlue.
AtomicTokenProxy.swapWithGasTokens: wraps swapAndSend and refunds gas via gas token freeFromUpTo with user supplied gas quantity.
msg.sender: caller identity used for authorization checks, token claims, trade events and as default recipient.
delegatecall to exchange.swap at doDistributedSwap, executing untrusted module code in AtomicBlue storage context.
address(target).call.value(value)(callData) in doDistributedSwap with fully user-controlled target, value and calldata.
recipient.send(amount) native ETH transfer inside AtomicUtils.send, triggering the recipient fallback with 2300 gas.
External ERC20 calls: transfer, transferFrom and approve on a caller supplied token address.
SwapParams _swap parameter carrying sellToken, input, buyToken and minOutput through AtomicBlue and the proxy.
DistributionParams _distribution parameter carrying exchangeModules, exchangeData and chunks used to route the swap.
address payable _receipient parameter that receives the swap output and triggers the ETH send path.
uint thisInput local computed as _swap.input * chunks[i] / totalChunks before each routed swap.
uint totalChunks local accumulator summing all chunk values without overflow protection.
address newRegistrar parameter written into the moduleRegistrar state variable.
address module parameter used as the key when updating the isModule whitelist mapping.
uint _gasQtyPerToken parameter used as a divisor in the gas refund accounting of the gas token wrappers.
Inline assembly blocks in validateOptionalERC20Return and sliceBytes performing raw returndatasize/returndatacopy and manual memory pointer arithmetic.

edges.reason: onlyRegistrar modifier requires moduleRegistrar == msg.sender before registerModule can write the isModule whitelist.
onlyRegistrar modifier gates setNewRegistrar on msg.sender, allowing the registrar to transfer its own privileged role.
msg.sender is emitted as trader in Trade and drives the payable swap path of AtomicBlue.swapAndSend.
msg.sender is the token source and default recipient in AtomicTokenProxy swap entrypoints.
AtomicBlue.swapAndSend delegates the actual swap execution to doDistributedSwap.
After the swap the output is pushed to a user supplied recipient via send, giving that address a hook into the live swap context.
doDistributedSwap performs an arbitrary low-level call with value and user supplied calldata, allowing the target to reenter while output balances are unsettled.
doDistributedSwap delegatecalls every exchange module, so arbitrary code runs in the executor context whenever a module is whitelisted.
The isModule whitelist mapping is the only authorization deciding whether a delegatecall target is accepted.
moduleRegistrar state variable determines who is allowed to add delegatecall targets to isModule.
Native ETH send invokes the recipient fallback, which can call back into AtomicBlue swap entrypoints.
A caller controlled ERC20 token can execute code during transfer and reenter AtomicBlue.swapAndSend.
AtomicTokenProxy.swapAndSend first claims the sell token from the sender before forwarding the swap.
The proxy forwards msg.value and user arguments to the AtomicBlue executor, which in turn pushes funds to an arbitrary recipient.
claimTokenFromSenderTo performs an external token.transferFrom call on a caller supplied token.
approve performs an external token.approve call on a caller supplied token.
AtomicUtils.send uses recipient.send(amount) to move native ETH out of the contract.
AtomicUtils.send performs an external token.transfer call for ERC20 outputs.
doDistributedSwap returns balanceOf(buyToken) as the measured swap output.
totalChunks is accumulated with unchecked addition across all chunks in doDistributedSwap under solc 0.6.12.
thisInput is computed as _swap.input * chunks[i] / totalChunks with unchecked multiplication and a potential zero divisor.
swapWithGasTokens wraps swapAndSend and then performs gas refund bookkeeping.
User supplied _gasQtyPerToken is used as a divisor in (startGas - gasleft() + 25000) / _gasQtyPerToken.
The _receipient parameter directly controls the destination of the native ETH send.
_distribution supplies exchangeModules, exchangeData and chunks that drive every external call and delegatecall in doDistributedSwap.
_swap supplies tokens, input amount and minOutput consumed by doDistributedSwap.
AtomicBlue.swap calls swapAndSend with msg.sender as the recipient.
multiPathSwapAndSend loops over the path invoking doDistributedSwap for each hop.
AtomicTokenProxy.multiPathSwapAndSend claims the sell token from the sender before execution.
The newRegistrar parameter is stored into the moduleRegistrar state variable.
The module parameter is used as the mapping key when updating the isModule whitelist.
The proxy externally calls AtomicBlue.multiPathSwapAndSend with value, entering the executor that forwards funds to arbitrary recipients.
validateOptionalERC20Return relies on inline assembly returndatasize/returndatacopy to interpret token return data.
sliceBytes uses inline assembly memory pointer arithmetic on top of the unchecked _start + _length bounds check.

normalization_plan.reason: SwapParams _swap is only threaded into doDistributedSwap, so it should be folded into that core function node.
DistributionParams _distribution exclusively parameterizes the external calls and delegatecall routing inside doDistributedSwap.
The _receipient parameter exists solely to direct the native ETH send unsafe operation.
LOCAL_thisInput is produced and consumed entirely inside doDistributedSwap's routing loop.
LOCAL_totalChunks is an internal accumulator of doDistributedSwap used for swap routing proportions.
newRegistrar is the sole argument of setNewRegistrar and should merge into that core function node.
The module parameter is the sole key argument of registerModule and should merge into that core function node.
_gasQtyPerToken is consumed only by the gas refund arithmetic of swapWithGasTokens.
